criteria.description: filterProducts must not mutate the original input products array; sort operations must operate on a copy.
criteria.evidence: All sorting tests pass without observable side-effects. Code inspection of src/utils/productFilters.ts confirms spread copy before sort: lines 21-25 show `result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)`, `result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price)`, and `result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating)` — each creates a new array before sorting.
